status: Both defects attributed on the published pin; isolated repaired probes pass. Final combined platform and consumer qualification remains open.

range_insertion.baseline_diagnostic: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: member call on null btree_node pointer at btree/btree.h:1054
range_insertion.cause: Unique and duplicate-key range insertion caches cend() across mutations.
range_insertion.correction: Reacquire the end hint for each insertion.

first_comparator_copy.cause: Lookup copies the comparator after allocating a zero-count root and before the value-construction cleanup boundary.
first_comparator_copy.correction: Route the first entry directly through internal_emplace, without empty-tree lookup.
